overview: The committee reviewed six refined design alternatives for the new high school and deliberated on over 200 space change proposals. Members approved a series of staff-led space reductions but voted to table more controversial proposals until detailed financial data and tax impact projections are available in late May.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the April 15th building committee meeting.

items.title: Design Alternative Updates
items.summary: SMMA presented six refined design options, highlighting improvements in site circulation, phasing strategies, and the potential to eliminate modular classrooms in four of the six schemes.

items.title: Resolution: Cost Estimating Instructions
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing cost estimators to provide specific breakdowns for varied parking designs, pool configurations, and auditorium sizes ranging from 500 to 1,000 seats.

items.title: Resolution: Space Proposal Procedure
items.summary: Adopted a procedure to categorize over 200 space change proposals into three tiers based on their alignment with the established educational plan.

items.title: Resolution: Financial Review Meeting
items.summary: Approved dedicating the May 27th meeting to a comprehensive review of city debt capacity, tax impact ranges, and capital needs following a debate regarding the project's total cost.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Community members expressed concerns regarding the high cost of the project and potential tax burdens, while others advocated for preserving the pool, special education spaces, and community amenities.

items.title: Category A Space Change Proposals
items.summary: Approved approximately 30 space reductions and repurposings recommended by the educational leadership team, including the consolidation of office suites and storage areas.

items.title: Categories B and C Space Change Proposals
items.summary: Tabled all remaining space change proposals in Categories B and C until updated cost estimates and city financial data are presented at future meetings.
